item.title: Your Tears by C37
item.description: Listen to the preview! “Your Tears” by C37 is a self-reflective instrumental composition that blends organic, synthesized, and guitar sounds to create a unique, heartfelt piece of music. Inspired by the artist’s beautiful surroundings in the Lake District, UK, the track reflects a deep sense of atmosphere and emotional connection.

item.title: Desire by Vince Robson
item.description: Listen to the preview! “Desire” by Vince Robson is an atmospheric, uptempo rock-pop track featured on the album Movie Soundtracks to Non-Existent Movies. The song showcases driving, high-energy instrumentation, with lyrics that portray Satan as an irresistible, fiery, and slightly dangerous woman who gets what she wants.

item.title: Just For You by Daimon D.
item.description: Listen to the preview! “Just For You” is the first single from Daimon D.’s third album, Selene. The song focuses on mental health, following a patient who escapes from an asylum to reunite with the girl he loves, though his flight to freedom may be a figment of his imagination.

item.title: Dreamland by Luma Saint
item.description: Listen to the preview! Luma Saint’s “Dreamland” is a euphoric melodic house anthem, with big synths, emotional energy, and the perfect late-night vibe made for festival lights and city skylines.
